description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of Intestate in Homagama D/S Division & Other Properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically the registration of title for intestate properties under the Registration of Title Act. It contains notices calling for claims to properties of deceased individuals, detailed land parcel information (cadastral maps, parcel numbers, extents), and procedures for land title registration. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification as it primarily concerns land ownership, title registration, and property transfers through inheritance processes.
